message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "AbstractUnArchiver", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "In extractFile, the archive entryName parameter (tainted from the configured ZipEntry.getName source) is passed to FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName) to build the output File f. No containment check, canonical-path check, or allow-list is performed before f reaches new FileOutputStream(f), so a malicious entryName containing ../ segments can write outside the intended destination directory."}]}
